facts.fact: The interior ministry's presentation to the EGMRG states that since 2018 the national identification number is generated automatically from the RNAEC, so that each newborn has a birth act and a NIN at the end of its registration; deaths are not mentioned.

facts.fact: The interior ministry's presentation states that since 2018 the NIN is generated automatically from the national automated register (RNAEC) and the newborn holds its birth act and NIN at the end of its registration; it does not describe the entry at the commune office in more detail.

facts.fact: The RNAEC is presented by an official of the Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Transport as its own register, created in 2014, with unified national governance of civil-status data; date is that of the presentation (EGMRG, 17-21 July 2026).
